Sam Chen: hey team! sam here — starting today as a data platform engineer. two quick things: laptop shows 'awaiting pickup' on the portal, any ETA? and who should I ping for credentials to the analytics cluster? fun fact: I grow hot peppers on my balcony and made a tiny hot sauce label. :hot_pepper:

Priya Rao: welcome sam!! i'm your onboarding buddy. i'll DM a 1:1 and set up a repo walkthrough. for cluster creds ping eng-infra-bot; IT will usually give a temp vm while creds finish.

Logan Wu: hi sam :wave: added you to the #data-platform channel and to the analytics team on GitHub. our weekly sync is Thu 11am PT. also re: dotfiles we have a minimal starter you can clone.

it-helpdesk: Ticket IT-5210 created for Sam Chen: Temporary dev VM provisioned. SSH: schen@temp-dev-402.redwood.internal. Key is in 1Password -> "IT Temp Keys". Laptop status: "shipped".

eng-infra-bot: Added Sam Chen to org "redwood-inference". Teams assigned: analytics-backend, data-platform. Please accept the GitHub invite sent to your email.

Sam Chen: thanks all — temp VM worked. will accept invites and join the sync. also posting a pic of my jalapeño plant later :seedling:

Nora (People Ops): welcome sam! virtual new-hire welcome coffee at 11am PT tomorrow if you want to join and show the hot sauce label. :coffee:

Sam Chen: i'll be there — excited to meet everyone!
